paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Elazar ben Perata.
So he is listed in Yuchasin, but Hyman has not found this name anywhere. Perhaps the intended reference is Sanhedrin 22a; our reading, however, is רש״בא speaking in the name of ר״א ben Perata.

notes.text: The proposed correction replaces an apparent father-son chain with a report formula. Hyman’s statement that he found no such name is not a new search of all sources.

The consulted Sanhedrin has Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar reporting in the name of Rabbi Eliezer ben Perata. Hyman’s heading and the abbreviated transmission in his text are separate occurrences. His report about Yuchasin awaits collation.
